driver-gloves-brocade-crane.name: ★ Driver Gloves | Brocade Crane
driver-gloves-brocade-crane.desc: These driving gloves offer protection from the elements while still maintaining tactile sensation.

ak-47-hydroponic.name: AK-47 | Hydroponic
ak-47-hydroponic.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been painted with a bamboo motif using metallic paints.

Notice how Gunsmith Yukako used the wood of the AK-47 to accentuate her verdant theme... make no mistake: Hydroponic is as beautiful and deadly as nature itself - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

ak-47-legion-of-anubis.name: AK-47 | Legion of Anubis
ak-47-legion-of-anubis.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. A custom paint job featuring Egyptian gods Anubis and Ra, representing the balance between life and death, has been applied.

May he tip the scales in your favor

ak-47-emerald-pinstripe.name: AK-47 | Emerald Pinstripe
ak-47-emerald-pinstripe.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been given a bog oak stock and painted a white and green pinstripes.

Questioning Imogen is questioning me. Now Relax, have some scotch, and let's talk business - The Father and The Phoenix Part 2

ak-47-olive-polycam.name: AK-47 | Olive Polycam
ak-47-olive-polycam.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. It has been custom painted using a green and grey halftone pattern.

Attention to detail

aug-amber-fade.name: AUG | Amber Fade
aug-amber-fade.desc:
Powerful and accurate, the AUG scoped assault rifle compensates for its long reload times with low spread and a high rate of fire. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

awp-neo-noir.name: AWP | Neo-Noir
awp-neo-noir.desc:
High risk and high reward, the infamous AWP is recognizable by its signature report and one-shot, one-kill policy. It has been custom painted with two stylized blue-magenta women over a grayscale background.

"They took comfort in each other's despair"

bayonet-doppler-sapphire.name: ★ Bayonet | Doppler
bayonet-doppler-sapphire.desc:
Relatively unchanged in its design since World War II, the bayonet still retains a place in modern military strategy. Bayonet charges have continued to be effective as recently as the second Gulf War and the war in Afghanistan. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

pp-bizon-harvester.name: PP-Bizon | Harvester
pp-bizon-harvester.desc:
The Bizon SMG is low-damage, but offers a uniquely designed high-capacity drum magazine that reloads quickly. It has been decorated with a bio-mechanical motif.

Biomechanic experimentation gone right

cz75-auto-pole-position.name: CZ75-Auto | Pole Position
cz75-auto-pole-position.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been custom painted with a red and grey racing theme.

We only get one chance at this, let's do it right - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

cz75-auto-crimson-web.name: CZ75-Auto | Crimson Web
cz75-auto-crimson-web.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

desert-eagle-cobalt-disruption.name: Desert Eagle | Cobalt Disruption
desert-eagle-cobalt-disruption.desc: As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been covered in a metallic foil stamped with a digital disruptive pattern.

desert-eagle-conspiracy.name: Desert Eagle | Conspiracy
desert-eagle-conspiracy.desc: As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. It has been painted with dark, metallic paint and pale yellow accents.

desert-eagle-light-rail.name: Desert Eagle | Light Rail
desert-eagle-light-rail.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. Its custom paint job creates an optical illusion and appears to change the weapon's geometry.

Required power supply sold separately

dual-berettas-hideout.name: Dual Berettas | Hideout
dual-berettas-hideout.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has been custom painted with a multicolored design.

Step right up, don't be shy

dual-berettas-tread.name: Dual Berettas | Tread
dual-berettas-tread.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. Both Berettas have been hand etched using a wave pattern. The slides have been painted gold.

Fine details take the longest, add the most, and are noticed the least

dual-berettas-panther.name: Dual Berettas | Panther
dual-berettas-panther.desc: Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has been painted in a black, grey and red color scheme.

dual-berettas-demolition.name: Dual Berettas | Demolition
dual-berettas-demolition.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has individual parts spray-painted black and tangerine orange.

Rona is as good as she thinks she is... she's just not old enough to realize she shouldn't point it out to everyone - Felix Riley, Commanding Officer

famas-survivor-z.name: FAMAS | Survivor Z
famas-survivor-z.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been stenciled using masking tape then distressed.

What's red and white and fires full auto?

famas-zx-spectron.name: FAMAS | ZX Spectron
famas-zx-spectron.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. This custom paint job uses gaming PCs of old as inspiration. Its black base has been finished with multicolored accents.

Clive would be proud

famas-mecha-industries.name: FAMAS | Mecha Industries
famas-mecha-industries.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It's stark white and black design make it feel like it came from a sci-fi show.

Spikey blue hair and robot companion not included

five-seven-silver-quartz.name: Five-SeveN | Silver Quartz
five-seven-silver-quartz.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been painted with metallic paint and uses a crystallizing mask to create a pattern.

Everyone wants to make an impact

five-seven-retrobution.name: Five-SeveN | Retrobution
five-seven-retrobution.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It was been custom painted with a retro hydrographic.

Some things never go out of style

g3sg1-ancient-ritual.name: G3SG1 | Ancient Ritual
g3sg1-ancient-ritual.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. A maroon and silver pattern featuring intricate linework and ancient creatures has been applied.

The privilege is yours

g3sg1-violet-murano.name: G3SG1 | Violet Murano
g3sg1-violet-murano.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. A pattern of orange and blue Murano beads has been applied.

Death by a thousand beads

g3sg1-varicamo.name: G3SG1 | VariCamo
g3sg1-varicamo.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. It has been painted using a VariCamo patterned hydrographic.

Rebuilding only comes in the wake of destruction

g3sg1-new-roots.name: G3SG1 | New Roots
g3sg1-new-roots.desc:
The pricy G3SG1 lowers movement speed considerably but compensates with a higher rate of fire than other sniper rifles. It has been spray-painted with a vine and flower pattern in various shades of green.

Room to grow

galil-ar-stone-cold.name: Galil AR | Stone Cold
galil-ar-stone-cold.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been highlighted with metallic blue paint.  The stock and magazine bare its designer's mark.

Eventually you need to step outside of your mentor's shadow

galil-ar-vandal.name: Galil AR | Vandal
galil-ar-vandal.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. Its green base coat has been covered with scattered white drawings.

Each drawing tells a story, some more memorable than others

galil-ar-kami.name: Galil AR | Kami
galil-ar-kami.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. It has been painted using a hydrographic in a Japanese manga pattern.

Some ghosts won't stay buried

glock-18-ironwork.name: Glock-18 | Ironwork
glock-18-ironwork.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. The slide has been laser etched to depict ivy and thorns.

Left unchecked, any garden becomes a tangled mass of weeds

glock-18-axia.name: Glock-18 | AXIA
glock-18-axia.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been custom painted with bright blue metallic flake paint and finished with AXIA branding.

"AXIA SPORTS—we compete so you don't have to!"

p2000-grassland.name: P2000 | Grassland
p2000-grassland.desc: Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a grassland color scheme.

butterfly-knife-marble-fade.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Marble Fade
butterfly-knife-marble-fade.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated in three colors.

The blade is made of many colors, but soon it all looks red

survival-knife-scorched.name: ★ Survival Knife | Scorched
survival-knife-scorched.desc:
This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

falchion-knife-black-laminate.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Black Laminate
falchion-knife-black-laminate.desc: A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been stonewashed and given a black laminate handle.

falchion-knife-forest-ddpat.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Forest DDPAT
falchion-knife-forest-ddpat.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

gut-knife-ultraviolet.name: ★ Gut Knife | Ultraviolet
gut-knife-ultraviolet.desc:
The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a black and purple color scheme.

Elegant design paired with brutal intent

navaja-knife-crimson-web.name: ★ Navaja Knife | Crimson Web
navaja-knife-crimson-web.desc:
This marble-enamel-handled flip knife conceals a small but viciously tapered blade. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

karambit-fade.name: ★ Karambit | Fade
karambit-fade.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been painted by airbrushing transparent paints that fade together over a chrome base coat.

This isn't just a weapon, it's a conversation piece - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

karambit-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Karambit | Doppler
karambit-doppler-phase-1.desc:
With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

karambit-gamma-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ Karambit | Gamma Doppler
karambit-gamma-doppler-phase-1.desc: With its curved blade mimicking a tiger's claw, the karambit was developed as part of the southeast Asian martial discipline of silat. The knife is typically used with a reverse grip, with the finger ring on the index finger. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

kukri-knife-forest-ddpat.name: ★ Kukri Knife | Forest DDPAT
kukri-knife-forest-ddpat.desc:
Used in traditional rituals, such as weddings or stabbings. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

m9-bayonet-case-hardened.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Case Hardened
m9-bayonet-case-hardened.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

nomad-knife-crimson-web.name: ★ Nomad Knife | Crimson Web
nomad-knife-crimson-web.desc:
This ergonomic tactical hunting lock-blade knife features composite handle inserts and a broad, sturdy blade, useful for cutting and prying apart material. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

shadow-daggers-doppler-sapphire.name: ★ Shadow Daggers | Doppler
shadow-daggers-doppler-sapphire.desc:
Designed for efficient brutality, using a push dagger is as simple as throwing a punch or two. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

skeleton-knife-case-hardened.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Case Hardened
skeleton-knife-case-hardened.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has been color case-hardened through the application of wood charcoal at high temperatures.

A little color never hurt anyone

stiletto-knife-forest-ddpat.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Forest DDPAT
stiletto-knife-forest-ddpat.desc:
Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

bowie-knife-doppler-black-pearl.name: ★ Bowie Knife | Doppler
bowie-knife-doppler-black-pearl.desc:
This full-tang sawback Bowie knife is designed for heavy use in brutal survival situations. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

huntsman-knife-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Doppler
huntsman-knife-doppler-phase-2.desc:
A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

huntsman-knife-gamma-doppler-emerald.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Gamma Doppler
huntsman-knife-gamma-doppler-emerald.desc: A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

huntsman-knife-slaughter.name: ★ Huntsman Knife | Slaughter
huntsman-knife-slaughter.desc:
A knife designed for modern tactical uses, the blade is well suited for a range of both combat and utilitarian needs.  The unique Tanto point allows for maximum penetration through even the toughest of surfaces. It has been painted in a zebra-stripe pattern with aluminum and chrome paints with various reflectivities, and has then been covered with a tomato red candy coat.

Valeria doesn't pay Javier to ask questions... she pays him to pry out answers

ursus-knife-ultraviolet.name: ★ Ursus Knife | Ultraviolet
ursus-knife-ultraviolet.desc:
This tanto-style survival knife features a faceted blade and full tang, complete with impact pommel. No fuss, no moving parts - just a reliable blade that's ready to work. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a black and purple color scheme.

Elegant design paired with brutal intent

m249-osipr.name: M249 | O.S.I.P.R.
m249-osipr.desc:
A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. This M249 has been custom painted in gunmetal grey and finished with a Combine logo.

Overwatch Standard Issue Pulse Rifle

m249-hypnosis.name: M249 | Hypnosis
m249-hypnosis.desc:
A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. It has been custom painted with an eye catching black and blue hypnotic design.

"Focus on the sound of my voice"

mp5-sd-co-processor.name: MP5-SD | Co-Processor
mp5-sd-co-processor.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. A blue circuit board pattern been applied.

Silently supplementing

mp5-sd-phosphor.name: MP5-SD | Phosphor
mp5-sd-phosphor.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. It has been custom painted by dripping neon pink, green, and teal paint onto its dark base.

Stand out from the crowd

mp5-sd-statics.name: MP5-SD | Statics
mp5-sd-statics.desc:
Often imitated but never equaled, the iconic MP5 is perhaps the most versatile and popular SMG in the world. This SD variant features an integrated silencer, making an already formidable weapon whisper-quiet. It has been custom painted with a black and blue design.

Black and blue and bloody all over

mp7-gunsmoke.name: MP7 | Gunsmoke
mp7-gunsmoke.desc: Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been painted using a hydrographic of a gel pen doodle.

mp7-army-recon.name: MP7 | Army Recon
mp7-army-recon.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It has been spray-painted freehand with short, thick lines in contrasting colors.

Perfect for the insurgent on the go

mp9-army-sheen.name: MP9 | Army Sheen
mp9-army-sheen.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has been covered in a metallic foil stamped with a camouflage pattern.

Remember your training

mp9-multi-terrain.name: MP9 | Multi-Terrain
mp9-multi-terrain.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. A green and brown multi-terrain camo pattern has been applied.

It's an early piece, but it still holds up - Imogen, Arms Dealer In Training

mp9-cobalt-paisley.name: MP9 | Cobalt Paisley
mp9-cobalt-paisley.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. A blue paisley pattern has been applied.

Only the finest textiles for you, Booth - Yukako, Gunsmith

mp9-storm.name: MP9 | Storm
mp9-storm.desc:
Manufactured in Switzerland, the cutting-edge MP9 SMG is an ergonomic polymer weapon favored by private security firms. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a stormy color scheme.

It will be waiting for you at the monorail

negev-ultralight.name: Negev | Ultralight
negev-ultralight.desc:
The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. It has been custom painted with a gray digital camo pattern and teal arrows.

Got a light?

negev-boroque-sand.name: Negev | Boroque Sand
negev-boroque-sand.desc:
The Negev is a beast that can keep the enemy at bay with its pin-point supressive fire, provided you have the luxury of time to gain control over it. An intricate, Italian inspired hydrographic pattern has been applied.

Last Supper is served

nova-koi.name: Nova | Koi
nova-koi.desc: The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been custom painted with variegated koi scales.

nova-ranger.name: Nova | Ranger
nova-ranger.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been painted with a brush stroke hydrographic and detailed with heat-transfer decals.

Who's keeping score?

nova-interlock.name: Nova | Interlock
nova-interlock.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. A yellow and blue optical illusion hydrographic pattern has been applied.

Did you get a good look?

p90-cold-blooded.name: P90 | Cold Blooded
p90-cold-blooded.desc: Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been painted with a chrome base coat and candied in transparent red anodized effect paint.  It has then been laser-etched with a slithering snake motif.

p90-asiimov.name: P90 | Asiimov
p90-asiimov.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been custom painted with a sci-fi design.

Anyone can predict the future... a visionary shapes it

sawed-off-analog-input.name: Sawed-Off | Analog Input
sawed-off-analog-input.desc:
The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been custom painted with diagonal bands of color and the letters "X", "Y", "B", and "A".

19 in 99

sg-553-integrale.name: SG 553 | Integrale
sg-553-integrale.desc:
The terrorist-exclusive SG553 is a premium scoped alternative to the AK47 for effective long-range engagement. A custom paint job paying homage to an Italian racing car has been applied.

"Accendete i motori!"

ssg-08-necropos.name: SSG 08 | Necropos
ssg-08-necropos.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. It has been hand painted with nefarious runes.

Every carpenter needs their hammer, every tailor their spindle...

ssg-08-calligrafaux.name: SSG 08 | Calligrafaux
ssg-08-calligrafaux.desc:
The SSG08 bolt-action is a low-damage but very cost-effective sniper rifle, making it a smart choice for early-round long-range marksmanship. A red calligraphy design has been applied.

Put it in writing

tec-9-whiteout.name: Tec-9 | Whiteout
tec-9-whiteout.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It is spray-painted all white.

It looks pure, but looks can be deceiving

tec-9-slag.name: Tec-9 | Slag
tec-9-slag.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been custom painted to appear handmade, from the grip to the welding on the receiver.

You have insurance, right?

ump-45-exposure.name: UMP-45 | Exposure
ump-45-exposure.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. A custom paint job has been applied which resembles an x-ray; rib cage and all.

"Please remove all metal objects from your pockets"

usp-s-orion.name: USP-S | Orion
usp-s-orion.desc: A fan favorite from Counter-Strike Source, the Silenced USP Pistol has a detachable silencer that gives shots less recoil while suppressing attention-getting noise. It has been custom painted in a modern graphic style.

xm1014-black-tie.name: XM1014 | Black Tie
xm1014-black-tie.desc:
The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. A vision in black and white chrome, this shotgun is best used on formal occasions.

We have Izaki and Cocinero. You need them for anything or can I just kill them now? - The Mercenary and The Serpent Part 1

classic-knife.name: ★ Classic Knife
classic-knife.desc: A classic of the Counter-Strike series, the edge of this knife is press-fit Stellite perfectly held in place due to its precise fit with the titanium on the blade's cheek and spine. The handle is fossilized mastodon ivory held in a carbon fibre pocket.

paracord-knife.name: ★ Paracord Knife
paracord-knife.desc: This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord.
